question: Which lifetime policy should reclaim unreachable recursive values without changing current identity or artifact semantics?
decision: Select a non-moving tracing collector over stable Rc-backed tracked storage. Preserve Value identity, aliasing, cycle-safe formatting, debugger behavior, and cdbc 0.1. At safepoints, derive roots from strong references outside tracked storage, trace tracked edges, and clear unreachable storage so Rc destruction reclaims cycles.

roots: live frame registers, locals, and closure environments
returned values and host-held strong Value references
tracked_edges: cell to aggregate or function closure
root_contract.borrow_policy: conservative when a tracked storage borrow is active

collection_policy.reclamation: clear references in unmarked storage and let Rc destruction release components

compatibility.debugger_and_errors: existing typed fields and display text unchanged
